# Voltstream

> Events in. Delivered. Every time.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/): What Voltstream does, when to use it, and how the pieces fit together.
- [FAQ](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/faq): Short answers to the questions support gets most often.

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/getting-started/quickstart): Publish your first event and receive it on a local endpoint in about five minutes.
- [Installation](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/getting-started/installation): Official SDKs for Node, Python, Go and Ruby, plus the CLI.
- [Authentication](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/getting-started/authentication): API keys, scopes, the two environments, and how to rotate without downtime.

## Guides

- [Webhook delivery](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/guides/webhook-delivery): What counts as success, the retry schedule, signature verification and endpoint health.
- [Idempotency](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/guides/idempotency): Why duplicates happen, and how to make handling them cheap on both sides.
- [Event filtering](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/guides/event-filtering): Send each endpoint only the events it cares about, using type patterns and payload predicates.
- [Rate limits](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/guides/rate-limits): The limits, the headers that report them, and how to back off correctly.
- [Replaying events](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/guides/replaying-events): Re-send history after an outage, a bug, or a new subscriber joining.

## Tutorials

- [Tutorial: build a production consumer](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/tutorials/build-a-consumer): A webhook receiver that verifies signatures, survives duplicates and does not lose work, start to finish.
- [Tutorial: migrate a partner from polling](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/tutorials/migrate-from-polling): Move an integration from a polling loop to events without a flag day, and without losing records.
- [Tutorial: fan out to many subscribers](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/tutorials/fan-out-to-many): One event, hundreds of customer endpoints, without one slow subscriber affecting the rest.

## API reference

- [Overview](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/api/overview): Base URL, conventions, pagination and versioning.
- [Streams](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/api/streams): Create, list, update and delete streams.
- [Events](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/api/events): Publish, batch, list, retrieve and replay events.
- [Endpoints](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/api/endpoints): Create, configure, test and rotate subscriber endpoints.
- [Error codes](https://docs.voltstream.io/docs/api/errors): Every error code, what causes it, and what to do about it.

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://docs.voltstream.io/blog): Every release, and what it changes for you.
